Forest HeraldPassive
Instant
Casting Toxic Dart and abilities that spend stacks of Advantage now have a 20% chance to spawn a green Dreamflower at a random location nearby within 15 yds of you.

You can only spawn Dreamflowers while in combat.
Dream Flower
When an ally runs over the flower, they consume it to heal for 3% maximum health and gain 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.
